title: The served app navigation names the package that contributed each folded entry (#27356 row 20)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. #27356 row 20 (Studio nav tree shows contributed entries greyed, with their package) was measured by the seat's card thread on `origin/main` `d770b150`: it cannot be built in Studio because the served app does not say which package contributed each entry. This is the producer half.
Reach: Studio › Interfaces nav tree on any app whose groups are filled by other packages' `navigationContributions`. HotCRM's Service and Marketing groups show "No items in this package" (`engine.studio.if.emptyGroup`, `NavTreeGroup` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`).
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/objectql`).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "applyNavContributions contributed nav entries package stamp No items in this package navigationContributions" → no open card covering it (#27343, #23803 and #16507 are closed and about other gaps).

## Observed
`SchemaRegistry.applyNavContributions` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`) folds each `navigationContributions[].items` entry into the target app's group (or top level) with no owner stamp. `appNavContributions` holds `packageId` per contribution, but the fold drops it, so even the served, merged app cannot tell a reader which package an entry came from.

## Wanted
On serve, stamp each folded item with its contributor's package id: a read-only system field in the style of `_packageId`. If the served app shape must declare the field, that is a spec touch, and the PR marks `Metadata-protocol` accordingly. The Studio half (NavTree / NavTreeGroup draws contributed entries greyed and read-only, with the package's label) follows as a `domain:ui` card once the field is served.

Dedupe words: applyNavContributions, navigationContributions, contributed nav entries, No items in this package, _contributedBy.

Related: #27356 (row 20).
